# ANSH&CO — Complete AI & Search Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

> Official machine-readable reference for ANSH&CO (https://anshandco.com/), an independent Brand Custodianship, Full-Stack Web & Mobile Engineering, AI Workflow Automation, and Viral Performance Marketing Studio headquartered in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Custodian Philosophy
ANSH&CO was established on the conviction that ambitious startups and legacy enterprises deserve long-term **Brand Custodians**, not transactional agencies that hand off a logo PDF and disappear. Operating 100% in-house from Aman Vihar, Dehradun, India, ANSH&CO unites senior software engineers, AI solution architects, brand identity designers, master video editors, and performance marketers under one roof.

### Key Studio Metrics
- **50+ Flagship Brands Architected & Scaled** across luxury skincare, hospitality, entertainment, beverages, real estate, and technology.
- **100% In-House Craft**: Zero freelance handoff loss; senior specialists execute every commit, vector, and frame.
- **6+ Years Average Client Partnership Tenure**: Long-term brand stewardship and equity protection.
- **3x Winner at India's Best Design Awards (IBDA) 2026** & **Certified Great Place to Work (2025–2026)**.

---

## 2. Four Core Pillars of ANSH&CO
1. **01 / Purpose & Strategy — Strategic Rigor**: Category anthropology, whitespace mapping, competitive differentiation matrices, high-intent audience psychographics, and commercial monetization alignment.
2. **02 / Radical Craft — Visual Architecture**: Proprietary typographic hierarchies, modular design systems, luxury tactile packaging & unboxing rituals, and spatial/environmental branding.
3. **03 / Full-Stack Tech — Bespoke Code & AI**: Headless React & Next.js architectures, sub-second Core Web Vitals optimization (99+ PageSpeed), custom CRM & ERP operational tooling, and generative AI production pipelines.
4. **04 / Long-Term Guardianship — Brand Custodianship**: Multi-year brand governance, rapid sprint agility, omnichannel message continuity, and direct senior leadership collaboration.

## 5. Pricing Transparency & Project Timelines
- **Pricing Model**: 100% upfront pricing transparency with zero hidden retainers or freelancer markups. Clients choose between **Fixed-Scope Sprint Milestones** (for brand overhauls, Next.js platforms, or AI/CRM builds) or **Monthly Brand Custodianship Retainers** (for continuous full-stack engineering, creative production, and paid growth).
- **Typical Delivery Timelines**:
  - High-Speed Next.js Websites & CRO Rebuilds: **2 to 4 weeks**
  - Comprehensive Brand Identity & Packaging Systems: **2 to 3 weeks**
  - AI Workflow Automations & Custom CRM/ERP Pipelines: **1 to 3 weeks**
  - Viral Performance Ad & Short-Form Reel Campaigns: **5 to 7 business days**
